when player_chat {
    if chat_message_equals("@lu_sb") {
        cancel_event()
        id = "lu_sb %player%"
        create_scoreboard(id, "&e&lМатч")
        set_scoreboard_line(id, "time", "&fВремя: &e60", 2)
        set_scoreboard_line(id, "online", "&fОнлайн: &a${value.player_count}", 1)
        set_scoreboard_score(id, "&fОчки:", 5)
        show_scoreboard(id)
        wait(10)
        set_scoreboard_line_display(id, "time", "&fВремя: &e59")
        set_scoreboard_score(id, "&fОчки:", 6)
        wait(10)
        hide_scoreboard()
        remove_scoreboard(id)
        send_message("lu_sb готово")
    }
}
